Observing report for November 17, 2026 Effelsberg observations (first block, 16:26 to 19:15 UT -> windstow). Windy (8-10 m/s, gusts of 15 m/s) and humid, light rain from about 18:00 UT. System temperature ~155 K. UGC11707 was followed-up for 20 min on source to check the marginal feature of November 13: it is not seen. 6dFJ2020317-04, 2MASXJ20124318 and GALEXASCJ19515 re-observed for 5 min on source each to cover whole pontential velocity range. From about 18:40 UT the wind was above 11 m/s with gusts of 17 m/s, with rain. The telescope was wind stowed at 19:20 UT. New redshifted maser setup for this night: band centered on 22150 MHz (-750 to +3150 km/s, LSR, radio definition), position switching (nodding) between the two horns (horn 1 is ok, horn 2 first time used for spectral line nodding: L pol is ok, R pol has some interference and no signal on line check). Submitted via GitHub issue #82 by @chickin.

Observing report for November 17-18, 2026 Effelsberg observations (second block, 18 Nov 00:32 to 05:26 UT). Two horn setup in nodding style observations Telescope windstowed from 19:20 to 23:40 UT, then set up again. Heavy clouds, wind ~5 m/s, humidity 94%. Heavy rain from about 05:30 UT ended the night at 06:00 UT. System temperature ~140 K. Last target block (04:30 to 05:26 UT) had quality issues due to not being able to get pointing solutions after the block, the sky was too noisy and rain started. KUG0937+327 interference near 22180 MHz in horn 1 R. SDSSJ121651.40 marginal detection, maybe artifact, and in the last compromised source block. Reobserving next session. Setup as in the first block: band centered on 22150 MHz (-750 to +3150 km/s), position switching between the two horns. Horn 1 is the normal feed, horn 2 is the usually unused one. The right polarization of horn 2 gave no sky signal during the whole night (most likely hardware issue, under investigation). Submitted via GitHub issue #84 by @chickin.

Observing report for session November 18-19, 2026 Effelsberg observations. Session: 18 Nov 16:35 to 19 Nov 06:43 UT. 55 targets, 5 min on source each. Fixed 300 MHz band centered on 22150 MHz, position switching between the two horns. Tsys ~125 K. No detections. Weather: overcast and wet all night (8 to 10 C, humidity 85 to 98%, wind 3 to 7 m/s). Showers around 18:00 and 20:15 UT, rain from 04:15 UT, heavy rain at 06:50 UT. Issues: potential pointing problems for 9 targets. NGC7292, UGC12009, WISEAJ213454.4, WISEAJ213114.9, WISEAJ213219.1: pointing off by 20 arcsec after the block. SDSSJ121651.40, WISEAJ121938.4, KUG1218+310: off by 21 arcsec after rain. ARP250: pointing source 24 deg away, check failed in rain. Flux scale from NGC7027, uncertain by ~15% (3C286 lost in rain). Horn 2 RCP gave no sky signal (possibly faulty cable, investigating). Reobservations: SDSSJ121651.40 (marginal on 17 Nov): feature at 695 to 720 km/s not there in 10 min on source. WISEAJ024326.8, WISEAJ231557.8, WISEAJ031452.8, WISEAJ031403.2, ARP250: re-observed to cover the red side missing on 13 Nov. Submitted via GitHub issue #86 by @chickin.

Showers around 18:00 and 20:15 UT, rain from 04:15 UT, heavy rain at 06:50 UT. Issues: potential pointing problems for 9 targets. NGC7292, UGC12009, WISEAJ213454.4, WISEAJ213114.9, WISEAJ213219.1: pointing off by 20 arcsec after the block. SDSSJ121651.40, WISEAJ121938.4, KUG1218+310: off by 21 arcsec after rain. ARP250: pointing source 24 deg away, check failed in rain. Flux scale from NGC7027, uncertain by ~15% (3C286 lost in rain). Horn 2 RCP gave no sky signal (possibly faulty cable, investigating). Reobservations: SDSSJ121651.40 (marginal on 17 Nov): feature at 695 to 720 km/s not there in 10 min on source. WISEAJ024326.8, WISEAJ231557.8, WISEAJ031452.8, WISEAJ031403.2, ARP250: re-observed to cover the red side missing on 13 Nov. Submitted via GitHub issue #88 by @chickin.
